rules.name: Mandatory Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) Validation
rules.article_citation: EMIR Article 9(1) - Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 148/2013
rules.description: Counterparty must possess a valid 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (LEI).
rules.explanation_template: Counterparty LEI is missing or invalid format (${Counterparty_LEI}) - required by EMIR Article 9(1)

rules.name: Positive Execution Price Requirement
rules.article_citation: MiFID II RTS 22 Article 15 - Transaction Price Fields
rules.description: Traded price must be strictly positive and greater than zero.
rules.explanation_template: Execution Price is negative or zero (${Price}) - violates MiFID II RTS 22 Article 15

rules.name: Positive Notional Volume & Quantity
rules.description: Transaction quantity must be strictly greater than zero.
rules.explanation_template: Transaction Quantity (${Quantity}) must be greater than 0 under CFTC Part 43 § 43.4

rules.name: Execution Timestamp ISO 8601 Compliance
rules.article_citation: MiFID II RTS 25 - Clock Synchronization & Timestamp Granularity
rules.description: Execution timestamp must follow valid UTC ISO 8601 format.
rules.explanation_template: Execution Timestamp (${Execution_Timestamp}) violates MiFID II RTS 25 UTC ISO 8601 clock sync requirement

rules.name: Standard ISO 4217 Currency Code Validation
rules.article_citation: FCA Handbook SUP 17 Annex 1 - Transaction Reporting Fields
rules.description: Currency code must be a valid 3-character ISO 4217 code.
rules.explanation_template: Currency code (${Currency}) is not a recognized ISO 4217 currency under FCA SUP 17

rules.name: Permitted Asset Class Categorization
rules.description: Asset class must be an eligible swap category: EQUITY, FX, COMMODITY, RATES, or CREDIT.
rules.explanation_template: Asset Class (${Asset_Class}) is not a permitted swap asset class under CFTC Part 45 § 45.3

rules.name: Trading Venue Market Identifier Code (MIC)
rules.article_citation: MiFID II RTS 22 Field 36 - Venue Identification
rules.description: Trading venue must be populated with a valid 4-character MIC or XOFF for OTC bilateral trades.
rules.explanation_template: Trading Venue (${Venue}) does not conform to ISO 10383 4-character MIC standard required by MiFID II RTS 22 Field 36

rules.name: Maturity Date Posterior to Execution Timestamp
rules.description: Derivative contract maturity date must be strictly posterior to the execution date.
rules.explanation_template: Maturity Date (${Maturity_Date}) is prior to or concurrent with Execution Timestamp (${Execution_Timestamp}) under EMIR Art 9(3)
